verdict.rationale: Square documents a first-party Payouts API, which is the product's own settlement surface, alongside separate Refunds and Disputes APIs. Its marketing also claims a unified sales report that reduces reconciliation work. However, the evidence is mostly bare page titles: nothing shows payouts being matched to bank deposits or itemized by fees, refunds, and chargebacks. missing for 10: documented payout-entry itemization of fees/refunds/chargebacks, settlement-to-bank-deposit matching, downloadable reconciliation reports, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can reconcile settlements to bank deposits with itemized reports covering fees, refunds, and chargebacks

citations.quote: See all your sales in one report. Spend less time reconciling data across payment systems
